news.title: The eternal complement
news.body: Advanced AI may matter most for the routine work behind breakthrough ideas. Explore why execution could shape the next economy and the pace of progress.

news.title: How Albertsons Companies is reimagining retail from the inside out
news.body: Albertsons Cos. is using ChatGPT Enterprise and the OpenAI API to help teams work faster and make grocery shopping easier for millions of customers.

news.title: Introducing Olmo-core 3: Open, scalable training infrastructure for large MoEs
MIT 将为公共交通机构开发 AI 协同平台
news.body: MIT Transit Lab 获得 Google.org 支持，计划建设公共交通智能枢纽，将实时监测、运营控制与乘客沟通信息整合起来，辅助调度人员决策。目前是开发项目，尚不能据此认定实际运营效果。
news.title_original: MIT Transit Lab to develop an AI platform for public transit agencies
news.body_original: With $2.1 million funding from Google.org, the open-source Public Transit Intelligence Hub will unify public transit monitoring, operations, and passenger communication.

news.title: 研究团队开发擅长不完全信息博弈的 Stratego AI
news.body: MIT 等机构将高效训练算法与隐藏信息决策方法结合，报告系统在 Stratego 中战胜高水平人类玩家，并测试其他策略游戏。游戏基准表现不等同于已验证的现实决策能力。
news.title_original: This game-playing AI is the new champ at Stratego
news.body_original: Able to defeat top-ranked human players and more efficient than other models, the new system could help decision-makers in military maneuvers or business negotiations.

news.title: OpenAI 披露并处置协同模型蒸馏活动
news.body: OpenAI 称其发现通过模型交互提取受保护推理的协同活动，并采取账户限制、技术修补及行业信息共享措施。文中归因属于公司调查判断，列出的请求数量也不等于成功提取次数。
news.body_original: Learn how OpenAI disrupted a campaign to extract protected model reasoning and is strengthening defenses against adversarial distillation.

news.title: OpenAI 与美国小企业发展中心合作开展 AI 培训
news.body: OpenAI 宣布与 America’s SBDC 合作，计划培训顾问并为小企业提供实践课程和本地指导，同时发布小团队使用 AI 的报告。培训覆盖目标属于计划，不能视为已实现的经营改善。
news.title_original: Helping small businesses put AI to work
news.body_original: OpenAI is partnering with America’s SBDC to expand hands-on AI training and local support for small businesses, alongside a new report on how small teams are using AI.

news.title: 开放 TTS 评测榜探索多语言语音与声音克隆评价
news.body: Hugging Face 介绍可扩展的开放语音合成评测，讨论人工偏好评估的覆盖和一致性限制。不同指标衡量的质量侧面不同，自动评分与榜单结果不能完全替代具体语言和使用场景中的听感评价。
news.title_original: Open TTS Leaderboard: Scalable Evaluation for Multilingual Text-to-Speech and Voice Cloning

news.title: Diffusion Controller：以轻量控制网络改善图像生成
news.body: Google Research 介绍可附加于图像生成模型的轻量控制网络，尝试将推理时引导与模型适配纳入统一框架，在提示词一致性和图像质量之间取得平衡。文中的效果来自作者测试，实际表现仍依赖基础模型与生成任务。
news.title_original: How Diffusion Controller unifies and simplifies AI image generation

news.title: NVIDIA 发布面向表格预测的 Kumo Tabular 开放模型
news.body: NVIDIA 介绍通过合成表格预训练的基础模型，将带标签样本作为上下文，直接完成新行的分类或回归预测。开发方报告了多项基准表现；无需任务微调不意味着无需真实业务数据验证。
news.title_original: NVIDIA Kumo Tabular Sets a New Accuracy-Efficiency Frontier for Tabular Prediction

news.title: MCP 智能体核验：事实正确，也要引用对来源
news.body: ProvenanceGuard 针对跨来源混淆：一句话可能在某处有依据，却被归到错误的工具或来源。作者提出将来源归属纳入核验，避免仅汇总证据后判定事实正确。
news.title_original: Getting the Source Right, Not Just the Fact: Source-Aware Verification for MCP Agents

news.title: DevDay 2026 回顾：持续工作智能体、模型与开发工具更新
news.body: OpenAI 汇总本次大会的模型、Codex、插件和协作产品公告，包含 GPT-6.1 Sol、dots 及云端开发工具。各项功能的推出阶段、地区和套餐范围不同，公告中的预览或未来计划不代表已向所有用户开放。
news.body_original: Explore more than 20 announcements from OpenAI DevDay 2026, including GPT-6 Astra, ChatGPT, Codex, APIs, security, and new tools for builders.

news.title: OpenAI 发布 GPT-6.1 Sol，侧重智能体任务的能力与成本
news.body: OpenAI 称新版 Sol 在代码、电脑操作和专业工作评测中较前代提升，并在部分任务上接近 Astra。发布文提供了测试条件与价格信息；这些是开发方评测，不能直接等同于所有真实任务的效果。
news.body_original: Meet GPT-6.1 Sol: near-Astra intelligence for coding, computer use, and professional work at one-fifth of Astra’s standard API input and output token prices.

news.title: 大家使用同一种算法，会发生什么？答案取决于场景
news.body: MIT 研究讨论招聘等场景中的算法同质化。研究认为，关于系统性排斥的担忧不能直接套用于所有情形；但共享算法形成的信息回音室，可能削弱探索和学习。
news.title_original: The effects of an “algorithmic monoculture” depend on the details
news.body_original: In a study focusing on hiring decisions, MIT researchers found the use of a single algorithm by many firms could benefit job seekers in certain situations.

news.title: 与机器交谈时，我们正在变成谁？
news.body: Sherry Turkle 在新书《Artificial Intimacy》中讨论聊天机器人的模拟共情与人际关系。文章基于访谈和作者观点，提醒人们审视用机器互动替代人与人交流的代价，并非临床因果结论。
news.title_original: Who we become when we talk to machines
news.body_original: Professor Sherry Turkle’s new book, “Artificial Intimacy,” offers a withering critique of chatbots and the antisocial dynamics she believes they encourage.

Here we present a potential that is universal within the class of water-free solid-state hydrogen-bond network mediated proton conductors rather than across chemistry and a database of 4.4 million first-principles configurations spanning 55 materials. papers.body: arXiv:2608.03280v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We present AccelNet, an exact, backward-compatible method for accelerating existing trained aenet and n2p2 neural-network potentials without retraining.
